reason: This Lake configuration transition adds AINTLIB for ECPP proofs, registers independent ECPP, real-closure, ordered-function, sign-determinant and probe/conformance/bench targets, and removes manual determinant experiments. It does not change the hexbz_factor_service executable declaration, its compiler options, any source or dependency in its native runtime import graph, or the pinned Mathlib revision. The HexRealClosure precompileModules flag affects elaborator-loadable artifacts for a separate library, not the measured integer-polynomial factorization service.
